title: San Jose, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to San Jose, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

San Jose is a city in CA with a population of 1,013,240. Heart of Silicon Valley with the highest salaries — and housing costs — in America. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 257 sunny days a year.
